description: This file implements the ServerControllerImpl class for IPC server control, including methods for setting failure states, checking cancellation support, and retrieving the client object.

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the server controller handling IPC server control functions such as failure handling and client management.

methods.name: ServerControllerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server controller with a client object and serial ID.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state with a provided reason string.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the operation has been canceled; always returns false as cancel is not supported.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback for cancel notification; not supported, so the callback is ignored.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the associated client object.
